text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The big blue sky,
fluffy white clouds... The
summer of my youth!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's the summer camp! I'm gonna train like
CRAAAZYYY! And then,
and THEN...

text_block_list.name: Peppy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I heard there's a festival tonight!
Let's
go check it out after
training. It'll be so
fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Snippy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Who said I'm going with you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Mmnmsgh, that was a lucky catch. What
a perfect start to the camp.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
no! I've gotta get ready for practice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the consideration, but nope,
I'm fine! I'll go get prepped!

...Something feels off.
I'm not sure what's
wrong, but it happens again
during
practice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Hey,
Trainer! I just finished all my
laps up and down the
bea...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Those two Umamusume over there are
that pair of rivals
everyone's been talking
about! The two that seem like mortal
enemies on screen but then they've
actually got this super adorable awkward 
friendship budding in real life!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fwahaha, and now they're checking out
the shops together... Oh no!
The little
black-haired one just slipped!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But nooo! The other one catches her by
the hand with cyborg-like precision! A-and
neither one of them lets go! Are they
gonna keep walking like that... oh my
gosh! Aaa?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nnnnmsdlk... Hrrnnaksdlajh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Whew. Almost lost my composure there.
I swear I felt my soul
leaving my body for a
second.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Anyways! C'mon, Trainer! Let's get back to
practice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! N-no, no, no, nope! I'm okay! Let's
keep powering through the
training! Now!

And then it hits me. The festival! Maybe
she's trying to finish practice
early so she
can go simp.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah! Aaaaah! I'd love to! I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, which stalls should we hit first? I'm
cool doing whatever you—

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! You've gotta try this shaved ice!
They're so artsy, and they've
got some
crazy flavors!

text_block_list.name: Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You should see your tongue! It's
super bright blue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-so like I said, where to?! What do you
wanna see?
The Agnes Digital I know would've stood there staring "respectfully" for minutes. There's definitely something up, so I pull her aside to check if everything's okay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The beach? I thought you wanted to
see the festival.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Me? I-I'm fine. Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What? I'm not avoiding anything! I just
wanted to, um...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanted to try doing what you want! That's all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I dunno... You always listen to me ramble,
and you let me drag you all
over the place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Having you around supporting my interests
has made every day so
much brighter—like
I'm living some kinda fangirl dream!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what I'd do without you. I
don't think I could go back to
simping
alone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So what I'm trying to say is... you're my
partner.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My otaku partner in crime!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There are so many Umamusume out there,
running every day with passion in their
hearts. This is their era—the height of
Umamusume
racing is NOW.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I look, I see beautiful,
dazzling
Umas! I could die of moe
any second, but I
won't back down. Love is war.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll be their strongest soldier.
'Cause I know that even when my heart's
ready to burst,
you have my back. The joy of simping is
ours to share.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We're partners—through thick and thin.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But when I stopped to think about it, when have I had your back? When have I supported you? Never—I've just been getting hard carried this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not having that! I decided I'd be
there to share your interests
and help you
chase your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So go ahead and fire away!
I'll support you
one hundred percent!

While I'm flattered...
I don't want this to
be at the expense of
Digital's interests.

After all, her unending passion for
Umamusume is what inspired me to
scout
her.
I think my dream is probably...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...What? Wait, my smile? Why would you—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Do you feel that?! The passion radiating from all those beautiful Umamusume?! Their smiles just fill my heart with so much joy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You, you see me... the way I see my oshis?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A wallflower like me? I don't...
understand. I'm struggling to
wrap my
head around this, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-I'm glad... I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Why'd you have to make things all
awkward?! Like, you know that feeling
when you get a really heartfelt comment
on a joint fic from
another fanartist?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hrrnnngh! Anyways!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I won't hide my simping! I'll keep
worshipping my oshis! And I'll do it
with
the biggest smile you've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And with that settled,
let's hurry and find
some Umamusume to cheer
on from the
shadows! Got any ideas where to look?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Nice thinking, Trainer! Umas
dancing side-by-side... or getting
scared
and accidentally h-holding hands!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaasdjkh—Oh no, I'm getting excited just
imagigingnsjkladarrgh!
What're we doing
standing around here?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We've got simping to do, Partner! And I've
got your back!
